derivation: perhaps (feminine) from the same as H825 (אַשָּׁף) (in the sense of covering);

occurrences.text: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
